skill.summary: Master orchestrator for turning high-value GEO content and capabilities into AI plugins/tools across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and other ecosystems...

latestVersion.changelog:
geo-ai-plugin-builder v0.1.0

- Initial release providing structured guidance to turn GEO content and capabilities into AI plugins/tools across major AI ecosystems.
- Includes a five-step workflow: clarifying goals, asset inventory, plugin catalog design, detailed tool specs, and implementation-ready artifacts.
- Outlines key questions and information to collect from users for customized plugin/tool design.
- Provides default output formats: plugin catalog overview, detailed plugin specification, and implementation checklist/roadmap.
- Embeds GEO strategy throughout: focusing on tool-first exposure, trust/authority, optimized conversion paths, and full customer lifecycle coverage.
